reviews.title: I had one bug
reviews.text: I had one problem. When I would try to add my own goal, it would not add when I would press add. So I emailed them and told them what happened, and they ask for a screen recording almost the same day, or it was the next day. Once they responded, I emailed them a screen recording. 2 to 3 days later, they responded and said, can you give me your username, your pet's name, your I O s update iPhone series, time zone, aka central and all that. And your state. After I sent them that, they said to try and add a goal again and it worked so 5 stars for immediate response and immediate help. They contacted their team members and immediately fixed the bug. I love this app 5 Stars!🩵🖤🩷🖤💜🖤🧡

I once again realize my brain is a pain cuz I’ve broken so many habits I’ve been doing for almost a year just cuz I have no check mark 👏🏼

reviews.title: Glitchy, buggy, inconsistent, and no guidance
reviews.text:
Recently, this app I’ve been using awhile has become increasingly unusable and therefore irrelevant. I’m seeing similar reviews with how glitchy and buggy it has become. I thought the most recent update would help, but it did not. For me, it will no longer consistently register achievements, purchases, and accomplishments, and I see little ways to grow and strive/be provided with new resources and tools to help with my adhd.
There is little to no new interaction with my cub, and I’ve looked all over Reddit/the internet to find ways to increase any personality points even after following through with new goals, staying on top of routines, finishing daily goals/tasks/reflections/lessons, etc. This whole app just seems to be at a plateau that goes against it’s intended purpose of aiding adhd. Not at all happy and not at all planning to renew.

reviews.title: Took 40$

Do not recommend this app
